units.source_text: 夜里睡不足，白天免不了要打盹儿。

en.t: When he did not get enough sleep at night, he could not help dozing off during the day.

units.source_text: 更令他担心的是：他的忍耐力老是半途而废。

en.t: What worried him even more was that his endurance always gave out halfway through.

units.source_text: 那是因为他老相信，这个计划失败了，还会有什么后路存在。

en.t: That was because he kept believing that even if this plan failed, there would still be some way out left.

units.source_text: 打那以后，又过了一星期……

en.t: After that, another week passed...

units.source_text: 已经快到提交“搜索书”的时候了。

en.t: It was nearly time to file a search request.

units.source_text: 头三天是请了假的。

en.t: For the first three days, he had taken leave.

units.source_text: 可之后完全是无故旷工。

en.t: But after that, it was simply absence from work without any excuse.

units.source_text: 那些本就对别人行动神经过敏的同事们，对这事绝不会放过。

en.t: His colleagues, already oversensitive to other people's movements, would never let this matter pass.

units.source_text: 恐怕当晚，某位性急的就会偷偷地去他家窥探。

en.t: Most likely, that very night, some impatient person would sneak over to his house to pry.

units.source_text: 让西晒太阳烤得发烫的房间，一个煞风景的房间，房内腾起一股酸腐气味，告诉着来人“家里的主人不在”。

en.t: The room, baked hot by the western sun, a dreary room, would give off a sour, rotten smell that told the visitor, "the master of the house is not here."

units.source_text: 访问者也许对从这个洞穴里解放出来的好运气的住户还抱着本能的嫉妒呢。

en.t: The visitor might even feel an instinctive jealousy toward the lucky resident who had been freed from this cave.

units.source_text: 于是，第二天，充满挖苦意味的谣言，紧蹙的眉头、添上了讽刺歪曲的手指之类的东西，通过交头接耳的方式传播。

en.t: And so, the next day, sarcastic rumors, knitted brows, and fingers twisted with insinuation would spread by whispered conversation.

units.source_text: 理所当然……

en.t: Naturally...

units.source_text: 就是他本人，内心也并非没有一点期待。

en.t: Even he himself was not entirely without a trace of expectation inside.

units.source_text: 事实上，他曾希望通过这次有些怪异的休假，把那种效果传达给同事们……

en.t: In fact, through this somewhat strange leave of absence, he had hoped to convey that effect to his colleagues...

units.source_text: 实际上，让教师这种嫉妒虫缠上的东西也实在很少见……

en.t: In reality, there were very few things that could be haunted by the envious creature called a teacher...

units.source_text: 学生们每年都像河里的流水，从自己身边越过，奔流而去，只有教师必须留下来，像深深沉在河底的石头。

en.t: Every year the students passed by him like water in a river and rushed away, while only the teacher had to remain, like a stone sunk deep on the riverbed.

units.source_text: “希望”只是对他人说的东西，而不是自己所梦见的东西。

en.t: "Hope" was something spoken to others, not something one dreamed of for oneself.

units.source_text: 他们感到自己像破烂，落入孤独的自虐趣味之中；要不然，就是不断告发别人的越轨行为，沦落为疑惑深深的“有德之士”。

en.t: They felt like rags and sank into a lonely taste for self-torment; otherwise, they kept denouncing other people's deviations and degenerated into deeply suspicious "men of virtue."

units.source_text: 过于憧憬自由自在的行动，变得不得不憎恨自由自在的行动……

en.t: Longing too much for free and unrestrained action, they came to have no choice but to hate free and unrestrained action...

units.source_text: 是个事故？

en.t: Was it an accident?

units.source_text: ……就算是事故，也该有个联系吧……

en.t: ...Even if it was an accident, surely there should have been some contact...

units.source_text: 那么，是自杀？

en.t: Then was it suicide?

units.source_text: ……瞧，还是惊动警察呀！

en.t: ...See, in the end the police still have to be brought in!

units.source_text: ……那个该道喜的男人，你，决不该过于自信哟……

en.t: ...You fortunate man who ought to be congratulated, you must never be too confident...

units.source_text: 是喽，是喽，他是自己为所欲为才失踪的，别人没有必要去多管闲事……

en.t: Yes, yes, he disappeared because he did whatever he pleased, and no one else needs to meddle in his business...

units.source_text: 可是，掐指算来，大约一星期了……

en.t: But counting it out on one's fingers, it had been about a week...

units.source_text: 实在是个惊扰别人的男人呐，他到底在想些什么，谁也不知道……

en.t: He really was a man who caused trouble for others; no one knew what on earth he was thinking...
